format: Six full 800x450 frames in a horizontal 4800x450 WebP atlas. Training: 900ms loop. Rest: 3000ms loop.
interpolation: None. Four original high-quality anime keyframes assembled in order 1,2,3,4,3,2 using Sharp; no generated intermediate frames.

prompts.kame:
Production animation KEYFRAME SHEET for Dragon Rush Z, classic Dragon Ball browser RPG. Exactly FOUR large animation keyframes arranged 2 columns by 2 rows, no gaps no borders; full sheet 16:9, every cell 16:9. Highest possible resolution. Ultra-clean detailed authentic Dragon Ball 2D ANIME CEL ART, sharp smooth ink outlines, richly painted atmospheric anime backgrounds, cinematic warm light, beautiful skin/clothing shading. NOT pixel art, NOT chibi, NOT 3D, NOT blurry or grainy. Designed to match a polished high quality anime game portal. Same locked camera and IDENTICAL environment, proportions, faces, scale and anchor positions in all four cells; only very subtle pose movement for smooth optical-flow animation. No text, interface, logos, frames or numbers. Full bodies visible with safe margins, correct anatomy, exactly two arms/two legs per person, correct hands and feet. Four phases go base -> slightly forward -> maximum subtle movement -> slightly back. Changes very small (about 1-2% of frame) to interpolate smoothly, no large pose changes, no face turning, no camera movement.
Scene: beautiful green rural training trail on the island of Master Roshi (Mestre Kame), blue sea and tropical trees in distance, pink Kame House far background. Young Goku and young Krillin in classic orange gis, blue belts and wristbands, realistic anime child/adolescent proportions, Goku's black spiky hair and brown tail, Krillin bald with six dots. Both carry a small wooden crate of MILK BOTTLES with exactly two hands and each has one turtle shell strapped to back. They jog on the spot side by side in a light coordinated bounce, feet stay around same anchors. Master Roshi stands in distant background wearing Hawaiian shirt and dark sunglasses with his wooden staff, watching. One loop: subtle torso and crate lift, heel lift, torso down, return. No Super Saiyan, no weights floating, no duplicate limbs or bottles. This is original Dragon Ball milk-delivery training, sharp sophisticated anime art rather than exaggerated tiny cute characters.
